resources.string: An affirmation, a thought, the date and how much of the year is left.
A quiet start to the day.
Put it on your home screen

1. Press and hold an empty spot on your home screen.
2. Tap Widgets.
3. Search for Daily Light and drag it where you want it.

Samsung tip: drop it on the screen you land on when you unlock, so it is the first thing you read.
Tap the card — on the home screen or here — to draw a different pairing. It resets to the day\'s own words at midnight.
